meanings.en: lacking imagination or excitement; dull and ordinary
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a rather prosaic explanation for his sudden departure.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani gidişi için oldukça sıradan bir açıklama yaptı.

meanings.en: to make something last longer than necessary
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyers tried to protract the negotiations to gain an advantage.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukatlar avantaj sağlamak için müzakereleri uzatmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: something that sticks out from a surface
meanings.exampleEn: A small protrusion on the rock made a good handhold for the climbers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayadaki küçük bir çıkıntı tırmanıcılar için iyi bir tutamak oldu.

meanings.en: only if; on the condition that
meanings.exampleEn: You can borrow the car, provided you return it by tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu gece geri getirmen koşuluyla arabayı ödünç alabilirsin.

meanings.en: connected with the parts of a country outside the capital city
meanings.exampleEn: She grew up in a quiet provincial town far from the capital.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkentten uzak, sessiz bir taşra kasabasında büyüdü.

meanings.en: having narrow or unsophisticated views
meanings.exampleEn: His provincial attitudes made it hard for him to accept new ideas.
meanings.exampleTr: Dar görüşlü tutumu yeni fikirleri kabul etmesini zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: cut off branches from a tree or plant to help it grow
meanings.exampleEn: The gardener pruned the rose bushes before winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçıvan kıştan önce gül fidanlarını budadı.

meanings.en: reduced something by removing unnecessary parts
meanings.exampleEn: The company pruned its budget to cut costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket maliyetleri düşürmek için bütçesini kıstı.

meanings.en: to try to find out private details about someone's life
meanings.exampleEn: I didn't mean to pry, but I couldn't help overhearing your conversation.
meanings.exampleTr: Burnumu sokmak istemedim ama konuşmanıza kulak misafiri olmaktan kendimi alamadım.

meanings.en: to force something open or apart with effort
meanings.exampleEn: He used a crowbar to pry the lid off the crate.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandığın kapağını açmak için bir levye kullandı.

meanings.en: the stage when a child's body becomes sexually mature
meanings.exampleEn: Most children reach puberty between the ages of ten and fourteen.
meanings.exampleTr: Çoğu çocuk on ile on dört yaş arasında ergenliğe ulaşır.

meanings.en: the activity of giving speeches to groups of people
meanings.exampleEn: She took a course to overcome her fear of public speaking.
meanings.exampleTr: Topluluk önünde konuşma korkusunu yenmek için bir kurs aldı.

meanings.en: a small amount of air, smoke, or wind blown out quickly
meanings.exampleEn: A puff of smoke rose from the chimney.
meanings.exampleTr: Bacadan bir duman bulutu yükseldi.

meanings.en: to breathe quickly and with difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: He was puffing hard by the time he reached the top of the hill.
meanings.exampleTr: Tepenin zirvesine vardığında zorla nefes alıyordu.

meanings.en: breathing hard, or blowing out air or smoke in short bursts
meanings.exampleEn: The old train was puffing slowly up the steep track.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı tren dik rayda yavaşça soluyarak ilerliyordu.

meanings.en: eager or quick to argue, quarrel, or fight
meanings.exampleEn: The pugnacious debater challenged every point his opponent made.
meanings.exampleTr: Kavgacı münazaracı, rakibinin ileri sürdüğü her noktaya itiraz etti.

meanings.en: to stop being involved in something or withdraw from it
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to pull out of the deal at the last minute.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket son dakikada anlaşmadan çekilmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: (of a vehicle) to move away from a place or into traffic
meanings.exampleEn: The train pulled out of the station right on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Tren tam vaktinde istasyondan hareket etti.

meanings.en: a small hole made by a sharp object, especially in a tyre
meanings.exampleEn: We had to stop because there was a puncture in the front tyre.
meanings.exampleTr: Durmak zorunda kaldık çünkü ön lastikte bir patlak vardı.

meanings.en: to make a small hole in something
meanings.exampleEn: The nail punctured the ball and all the air escaped.
meanings.exampleTr: Çivi topu deldi ve bütün hava kaçtı.

meanings.en: a completely clean, bright white with no other colour
meanings.exampleEn: The bride wore a dress of pure white silk.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelin bembeyaz ipekten bir elbise giymişti.

meanings.en: the process of removing dirty or harmful substances from something
meanings.exampleEn: Water purification is essential for providing safe drinking water.
meanings.exampleTr: Su arıtımı, güvenli içme suyu sağlamak için hayati önem taşır.

meanings.en: the state of being pure and not mixed with anything else
meanings.exampleEn: The purity of the mountain air was refreshing after the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağ havasının saflığı şehirden sonra ferahlatıcıydı.

meanings.en: claimed to be true or to be something, though possibly not so
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper published a purported confession from the suspect.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete, şüpheliden geldiği iddia edilen bir itirafı yayımladı.

meanings.en: to spend time or effort doing something
meanings.exampleEn: She put in long hours to finish the project on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi zamanında bitirmek için uzun saatler harcadı.

meanings.en: to make an official request or submit something
meanings.exampleEn: He put in a request for a transfer to another department.
meanings.exampleTr: Başka bir bölüme geçiş için bir talep sundu.

meanings.en: a loose set of shirt and trousers worn in bed
meanings.exampleEn: The children put on their pyjamas and got ready for bed.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar pijamalarını giyip yatmaya hazırlandı.

meanings.en: to drink something quickly or in large amounts
meanings.exampleEn: They quaffed several pints of ale at the tavern.
meanings.exampleTr: Meyhanede birkaç bardak birayı kana kana içtiler.

meanings.en: a serious newspaper aimed at educated readers, not a tabloid
meanings.exampleEn: He preferred to read a quality paper rather than the tabloids.
meanings.exampleTr: Bulvar gazeteleri yerine ciddi bir gazete okumayı tercih ederdi.

meanings.en: feelings of doubt or worry about whether something is right
meanings.exampleEn: She had no qualms about telling him exactly what she thought.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona tam olarak ne düşündüğünü söylemekte hiç tereddüt etmedi.

meanings.en: a platform beside water where boats are loaded and unloaded
meanings.exampleEn: The fishing boats were tied up along the quay.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıkçı tekneleri rıhtım boyunca bağlanmıştı.

meanings.en: in a way that is doubtful or open to question
meanings.exampleEn: The money was questionably obtained through undisclosed deals.
meanings.exampleTr: Para, açıklanmayan anlaşmalar yoluyla kuşkulu bir şekilde elde edilmişti.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you want an answer or have doubts
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at him questioningly, waiting for an explanation.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir açıklama bekleyerek ona soru sorar gibi baktı.

meanings.tr: kılı kırk yarma, önemsiz konularda tartışma
meanings.en: arguing about small, unimportant details
meanings.exampleEn: Stop quibbling over a few cents and let's make the deal.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç kuruş için kılı kırk yarmayı bırak da anlaşmayı yapalım.

meanings.en: to become faster or to make something faster
meanings.exampleEn: Her heartbeat quickened as she opened the letter.
meanings.exampleTr: Mektubu açarken kalp atışları hızlandı.

meanings.en: the quality of being fast or fast to understand
meanings.exampleEn: The boxer was admired for the quickness of his reflexes.
meanings.exampleTr: Boksör, reflekslerinin çabukluğuyla takdir topladı.

meanings.en: the state of being quiet, calm, or without noise
meanings.exampleEn: I enjoy the quietness of the countryside early in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabahın erken saatlerinde kırsalın sessizliğini severim.

meanings.en: the punctuation marks used to show the beginning and end of a quotation
meanings.exampleEn: Put the speaker's exact words inside quote marks.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşanın tam sözlerini tırnak işaretleri içine koy.

meanings.en: a person, animal, or vehicle that takes part in races
meanings.exampleEn: The young racer set a new record on the track.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç yarışçı pistte yeni bir rekor kırdı.

meanings.en: old and torn; wearing worn-out clothes
meanings.exampleEn: The beggar wore a ragged coat full of holes.
meanings.exampleTr: Dilenci deliklerle dolu yırtık pırtık bir palto giyiyordu.

meanings.en: uneven or rough in shape or line
meanings.exampleEn: The mountains formed a ragged outline against the sky.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlar gökyüzüne karşı girintili çıkıntılı bir siluet oluşturuyordu.

meanings.en: a person who walks in the countryside for pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: On Sundays the hills are full of ramblers enjoying the fresh air.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazar günleri tepeler, temiz havanın tadını çıkaran yürüyüşçülerle dolar.

meanings.en: the quality of happening without a pattern, plan, or reason
meanings.exampleEn: There is a certain randomness in which numbers come up in a lottery.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyangoda hangi sayıların çıkacağında belli bir rastgelelik vardır.

meanings.en: the quality of being very fast
meanings.exampleEn: We were surprised by the rapidity with which the news spread.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberin yayılma hızına şaşırdık.

meanings.en: the quality of acting too quickly without thinking of the results
meanings.exampleEn: He later regretted the rashness of his decision to quit his job.
meanings.exampleTr: İşini bırakma kararındaki düşüncesizliğinden sonradan pişman oldu.

meanings.en: the quality of being based on reason and clear thinking
meanings.exampleEn: He prided himself on the rationality of his business decisions.
meanings.exampleTr: İş kararlarındaki akılcılıkla övünürdü.

meanings.en: the moment when you suddenly understand something
meanings.exampleEn: The realisation that he had made a mistake came too late.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir hata yaptığının farkına varması çok geç oldu.

meanings.en: the achieving of something planned or hoped for
meanings.exampleEn: The new stadium was the realisation of a lifelong dream.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni stadyum, ömür boyu süren bir hayalin gerçekleşmesiydi.

meanings.en: became aware of or understood something
meanings.exampleEn: She suddenly realised she had left her keys at home.
meanings.exampleTr: Aniden anahtarlarını evde bıraktığını fark etti.

meanings.en: achieved something that was planned or hoped for
meanings.exampleEn: He finally realised his ambition of running his own company.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda kendi şirketini yönetme hırsını gerçekleştirdi.

meanings.en: appearing again after being absent or hidden
meanings.exampleEn: The sun kept reappearing between the passing clouds.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş, geçen bulutların arasından tekrar tekrar görünüyordu.

meanings.en: to think again about something to decide if you should change it
meanings.exampleEn: After the results came in, we had to reassess our strategy.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçlar geldikten sonra stratejimizi yeniden değerlendirmek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: to turn a computer off and then on again
meanings.exampleEn: If the program freezes, try to reboot your computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Program donarsa bilgisayarını yeniden başlatmayı dene.

meanings.en: to start something again in a fresh, new way
meanings.exampleEn: The studio decided to reboot the classic film series.
meanings.exampleTr: Stüdyo, klasik film serisini yeniden başlatmaya karar verdi.

meanings.tr: sözünü geri almak, tövbe etmek, dönmek
meanings.en: to publicly say that you no longer hold a belief or statement
meanings.exampleEn: Under pressure, the scientist was forced to recant his theory.
meanings.exampleTr: Baskı altında, bilim insanı teorisini geri almak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to repeat the main points of something briefly
meanings.exampleEn: Let me recapitulate the key arguments before we conclude.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitirmeden önce temel argümanları özetleyeyim.
